statements: After condition averaging, all four full-epoch comparisons still favor objective own-target reconstruction, while the RMSE gap between targets is smaller.

Candidate full-epoch RMSE exceeds objective RMSE by 0.0220–0.0322; the corresponding trial-label range was 0.0873–0.1250. This comparison of two executed pipelines cannot assign all changes to behavioral averaging.
No-collision conditions have lower candidate RMSE by 0.0892–0.1070 but lower correlation; the metrics do not jointly establish candidate superiority.
Post-collision candidate RMSE is higher by 0.2312–0.2628. Preserve this phase and condition-type difference rather than interpreting every phase through its full-epoch mean.
